impact.text: This affects ALL limit order matching (both partial and full matches), while fill orders remain unaffected as they use different validation logic.

precondition_sources.text: A limit order match (partial or full) is being processed in _processLimitBidOrder or _processLimitAskOrder.
The matched base amount and matched quote amount have no overlapping 1-bits (e.g., base = 256 and quote in {1..255}).

intent_sources.text: The zero-cost trade check must only reject trades where one side receives tokens without sending any, not legitimate trades whose matched amounts have disjoint bits.
Legitimate limit order matches with nonzero base and quote amounts must not revert with ZeroCostTrade().
